name: web_search
description: Find web pages, news, images, or videos that match a search query.
summary: These tools search the web for pages, news, articles, images, and videos, with options to filter results by region and content.

name: webpage_retrieval
description: Retrieve readable text, HTML, or formatted content from a specified webpage.
summary: These tools retrieve web pages and URL-hosted content as readable text, HTML, Markdown, or JSON, with options to limit or continue results.

name: sitemap_inspection
description: Explore, list, parse, and summarize the pages and structure of website sitemaps.
summary: These tools inspect website sitemaps by displaying their hierarchy, listing and filtering pages, summarizing size and structure, and extracting page details from text or XML.

investor-agent: A Financial Analysis MCP Server::get_financial_statements

investor-agent: A Financial Analysis MCP Server::get_crypto_fear_greed_index
servers: investor-agent: A Financial Analysis MCP Server

Crypto Price & Market Analysis MCP Server::get-market-analysis
Crypto Price & Market Analysis MCP Server::get-historical-analysis
servers: Crypto Price & Market Analysis MCP Server
summary: These tools provide current prices for cryptocurrencies and precious metals, crypto 24-hour statistics, exchange and volume breakdowns, and historical price analysis over selected periods.

name: crypto_research
description: Investigate cryptocurrency tokens using selected sources, keywords, and research resources.
summary: These tools create research plans, investigate cryptocurrency tokens using keywords or specified sources, search sources for token information, and list available research resources.

name: package_discovery
description: Find, compare, and discover software packages, repositories, and developers for a chosen purpose.
tool_ids: Context7 MCP - Up-to-date Code Docs For Any Prompt::resolve-library-id
servers: Context7 MCP - Up-to-date Code Docs For Any Prompt
summary: These tools compare, search, and find similar NPM packages, surface popular GitHub repositories and developers, and locate libraries with documentation references.

name: package_metadata
description: Inspect package versions, releases, dependencies, documentation, maintainers, and repository information.
summary: These tools inspect NPM and Maven packages, covering versions, releases and changelogs, dependencies, TypeScript support, maintainers, deprecation status, and version availability.

name: package_quality
description: Assess package security, maintenance, quality, popularity, size, and license compatibility.
summary: These tools assess NPM package sizes, security, popularity, repository statistics, license compatibility, and overall quality and maintenance.

name: developer_documentation
description: Browse software component catalogs, API references, examples, changelogs, and integration guidance.
tool_ids: Context7 MCP - Up-to-date Code Docs For Any Prompt::get-library-docs
servers: Context7 MCP - Up-to-date Code Docs For Any Prompt
summary: These tools retrieve package and library documentation, search icon collections, explain platform setup, and provide component APIs, examples, changelogs, catalogs, and implementation guidance for UI and device mockups.

name: league_strategy
description: Review League of Legends champion performance, builds, counters, rankings, and player leaderboards.
summary: These tools cover League of Legends champion performance, rankings, builds, counters, regional top players, current meta data, and skins on sale across positions and game modes.

name: game_player_analytics
description: Look up player profiles, rankings, match histories, and playstyle information across supported games.
summary: These tools retrieve League of Legends player rankings, win rates, and match histories, refresh OP.GG data, and show Valorant regional leaderboards and player match histories.

name: esports_info
description: Check professional League of Legends schedules and league standings.
summary: These tools show upcoming professional League of Legends matches and team standings for a selected league.

name: tft_strategy
description: Explore Teamfight Tactics compositions, item recipes, builds, and champion recommendations.
summary: Covers TFT meta decks, item recipes and combinations, champion item builds and recommendations, plus player-specific playstyle feedback using region and account ID.

name: valorant_strategy
description: Review Valorant agent and map statistics, meta trends, and team compositions.
summary: These tools provide Valorant map and agent meta information, map-specific team compositions, and character statistics with optional map filters.

name: game_reference
description: Search game card, character, skill, and equipment reference information.
summary: Searches and retrieves Yu-Gi-Oh! card details and images, and looks up Wuthering Waves Echo sets, character skills, development tips, and profiles.

name: news_content_discovery
description: Browse current news and popular or trending stories, discussions, videos, books, and other media.
summary: Tracks trending news, technology, business, entertainment, gaming, books, and videos across Chinese and international media platforms.

name: scholarly_research
description: Search, retrieve, download, and read biomedical and academic papers, including arXiv research.
summary: Search and retrieve biomedical papers, clinical trials, genetic variants, and arXiv research; plan investigations, access abstracts and full text, download papers, and manage stored research resources.

name: clinical_trials
description: Find clinical trials and retrieve their designs, eligibility rules, sites, outcomes, and references.
summary: Find clinical trials by condition and eligibility, then retrieve their designs, status, sponsors, dates, outcomes, results, adverse events, references, and site contacts.

name: genetic_variants
description: Search genetic variants, retrieve annotations, and predict potential effects on gene regulation.
summary: These tools search and annotate genetic variants, retrieve their clinical and population details, and predict effects on gene regulation, chromatin, splicing, and promoters.

name: public_dataset_discovery
description: Search public datasets and browse their details, groups, and tags.
summary: Search and browse Data.gov datasets, inspect dataset details, and list or search groups and tags with sorting, pagination, and field options.

name: place_discovery
description: Find places, addresses, nearby amenities, schools, parking, chargers, and neighborhood features.
summary: These tools locate addresses and coordinates, discover nearby places and amenities, recommend meeting venues, find schools, EV chargers and parking, and assess neighborhood accessibility and walkability.

name: route_planning
description: Plan trips between locations and compare routes, distances, travel times, and commute modes.
summary: These tools provide routes, distances, estimated travel times, and turn-by-turn directions between locations, and compare home-to-work trips across travel modes.

name: rail_travel
description: Look up rail stations and codes, search train tickets, and inspect routes and stops.
summary: These tools look up Chinese railway stations and codes, find direct or transfer train trips, and show route stops with arrival, departure, and waiting times.

name: weather_forecasting
description: Get current weather and forecasts for cities or geographic coordinates.
summary: Provides current weather and forecasts for coordinates or cities, with configurable temperature, wind, and precipitation units and optional country selection.

name: general_conversions
description: Look up dates and times, convert time zones, and check currency exchange rates.
summary: These tools provide timezone-aware times and dates, convert times across zones, and retrieve current or historical currency exchange rates.

name: accommodation_search
description: Find accommodation by location, dates, guest count, price, and availability.
summary: Find Airbnb stays by location, dates, guests, and price range, then retrieve listing details and availability for selected dates.

name: recipe_planning
description: Find recipes, look up cooking instructions, and plan meals around preferences and group size.
summary: These tools list and search recipes, plan weekly meals and shopping lists around dietary needs, suggest dishes for a group size, and provide recipe ingredients and instructions.

name: chinese_calendar

summary: These tools calculate or find matching Bazi charts from birth details and provide traditional Chinese calendar information for selected dates.

name: wikipedia_research
description: Search Wikipedia and retrieve, summarize, or explore article content, sections, facts, and links.
summary: These tools search Wikipedia, retrieve and summarize articles or sections, extract key facts, list sections and links, and find related topics, with optional question- or topic-focused analysis.

name: museum_collection
description: Browse museum departments and search for collection objects, details, and images.
summary: These tools list Met departments, search collection objects using queries and filters, and retrieve object details with optional images.

name: file_conversion
description: Extract, convert, combine, split, clean, format, and compare document and text files.
summary: These tools extract and transform document content, manage and convert PDFs, format and convert HTML, retrieve media links, and compare text files.

name: word_document_tools
description: Create, read, edit, format, annotate, search, secure, and convert Word documents.
summary: These tools create, copy, inspect, list, and edit Word documents by extracting text and managing headings, paragraphs, images, tables, and page breaks.

name: spreadsheet_tools
description: Read and write spreadsheet data, manage worksheets, and create or inspect tables.
summary: These tools read spreadsheet data and metadata, inspect formulas and styles, copy sheets, create tables, and write values or formulas in Excel files.

name: file_management
description: Read, write, search, organize, inspect, and manage files and directories.
summary: These tools list and inspect files and directories, read local or remote content, create and edit files, save SVGs, apply conflict-checked patches, and move or rename items.

name: data_visualization
description: Create charts, statistical graphics, and maps to visualize data, comparisons, distributions, and relationships.
summary: This group creates charts and maps for comparing categories, tracking trends, showing distributions and proportions, illustrating staged declines, and planning routes.

name: diagramming
description: Create or validate process, cause-and-effect, hierarchy, relationship, mind map, and canvas diagrams.
summary: The tools create, validate, and render diagrams and mind maps, build connected concept canvases, and draw, color, and export pixel-based images.

name: presentation_management
description: Create, load, save, inspect, and configure presentation files and templates.
summary: These tools inspect and load PowerPoint files, manage templates and metadata, refine slide-design requests, and create, build, and save presentations.

name: slide_editing
description: Build and edit slide content, layouts, text, images, tables, charts, links, and transitions.
summary: These tools create, copy, remove, inspect, and edit PowerPoint slides, including layouts, backgrounds, placeholders, text, bullets, and SVG images.

name: browser_automation
description: Navigate webpages, interact with page elements, capture content, run scripts, and manage browser sessions.
summary: These tools record and manage Playwright browser sessions, navigate pages, capture screenshots, and interact with page and iframe elements through clicks, typing, dropdown selection, and hovering.

name: http_requests
description: Send HTTP requests and track matching responses for web services.
summary: These tools send HTTP GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE requests, and track URL-matched responses for later inspection and text checks.

name: git_management
description: Inspect repository changes and history, manage branches, stage files, and create commits.
summary: These tools inspect repository status and changes, stage or unstage edits, create commits, review commit history and details, manage branches, and initialize repositories.

name: task_management
description: Plan and track multi-step work, inspect or edit tasks, and update request progress.
summary: Manage task requests and research sections by creating, queueing, tracking, approving, editing, removing, and finalizing tasks, while viewing details and updating section status.

name: knowledge_management
description: Search, read, write, organize, and manage notes, projects, and linked knowledge.
summary: These tools manage knowledge graph entities, details, and relationships; search and retrieve graph data; and delete, read, or gather related notes and files for context.

name: docker_management
description: Create, deploy, list, and inspect Docker containers and Compose stacks.
summary: These tools create Docker containers, deploy Compose stacks, retrieve container logs, and list Docker containers.

name: terminal_operations
description: Run commands, inspect process output, interact with sessions, and monitor or stop processes.
summary: These tools start and manage terminal processes, including reading output, sending input, checking status, listing active sessions, and forcefully stopping processes.

name: system_administration
description: Inspect server settings, access scopes, usage statistics, and feedback options.
summary: These tools inspect and configure PowerPoint server settings and access, monitor and terminate processes, report tool performance, open feedback forms, and list permitted directories.

name: chess_play
description: Set up chess games, inspect positions and legal moves, and play or search recorded moves.
summary: These tools manage chess games by displaying boards, turns, and legal moves; starting games; playing moves and reporting outcomes; and finding pieces in game records.

name: media_processing
description: Analyze image and audio content, inspect audio features, retrieve transcripts, and download media.
summary: These tools analyze images and audio, extract video transcripts, annotate image metadata, and measure audio duration, tempo, spectral properties, note activity, and beat positions, including downloading audio.

name: randomization
description: Generate random numbers or tokens, select items, and shuffle lists.
summary: These tools generate random numbers, select and shuffle list items, and create cryptographically secure hexadecimal tokens and bounded integers.

name: calculation
description: Evaluate mathematical expressions and return numerical results.
summary: Evaluates a mathematical expression and returns its result.

name: internet_registry
description: Look up registration and network ownership information for domains, top-level domains, IP addresses, and autonomous systems.
summary: These tools retrieve domain registration and contact details, top-level domain registry information, and registration and network ownership information for IP addresses and autonomous systems.

name: coding_practice
description: Find coding challenges and retrieve problem, contest, profile, submission, and ranking information.
summary: These tools retrieve daily challenges, specific and filtered problems, user profiles and submissions, contest details, and user contest rankings from LeetCode.

name: other
description: Tools that fit no listed domain.
summary: Helps work through complex problems step by step, revising ideas and exploring alternatives as needed.
